name: opencode-model-router
description: OpenCode plugin that routes tasks to tiered subagents (fast/medium/heavy) based on complexity

scripts.smoke: cross-env RUN_OC_SMOKE=1 vitest run --config vitest.smoke.config.ts test/smoke
scripts.smoke:keyless: cross-env RUN_OC_SMOKE_KEYLESS=1 vitest run --config vitest.smoke.config.ts test/smoke/registration.smoke.test.ts test/smoke/subagent-tiers.smoke.test.ts test/smoke/deferred-catalog.smoke.test.ts test/smoke/depth-effort.smoke.test.ts test/smoke/helpers/scripted-provider.test.ts
scripts.smoke:v2: cross-env RUN_OC_SMOKE_V2=1 vitest run --config vitest.smoke.config.ts test/smoke/v2-registration.smoke.test.ts
scripts.smoke:routing: cross-env RUN_OC_SMOKE_ROUTING=1 vitest run --config vitest.smoke.config.ts test/smoke/routing-engine.smoke.test.ts
scripts.smoke:v2:e2e: cross-env RUN_OC_SMOKE_V2_E2E=1 vitest run --config vitest.smoke.config.ts test/smoke/v2-provider-e2e.smoke.test.ts
